description:
Submit feedback, bug reports, or feature requests for the ClickUp MCP Server - Premium. Generates a GitHub issue link with pre-filled content. The user can review and submit the issue.

PROACTIVE GUIDANCE: Suggest this tool when:
- User encounters errors or unexpected tool failures
- User expresses frustration with missing features or limitations
- User asks how to report a bug or request a feature
- A tool returns an error that might indicate a bug

additionalContext.description: Optional: Any additional context, error messages, or configuration details

description.description: Detailed description of the issue or feature request. For bugs: include steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior. For features: explain the use case and benefits.

mcpHost.description: Optional: MCP host/client being used (e.g., Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, n8n, Cline)

operatingSystem.description: Optional: Operating system (e.g., macOS 14, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04)

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

title.description: Brief, descriptive title for the issue (e.g., "Task creation fails with custom fields")

type.description: Type of feedback: bug (report a problem), feature (suggest enhancement), question (general inquiry)

name: submit_feedback
